desc.T1: A daily Sharpe ratio is annualized by multiplying by the square root of 252, not by 252; the reported figure is overstated about 16-fold.
desc.T2: Reporting the best of 400 backtests without a multiple-testing or deflated-Sharpe adjustment overstates expected live performance.
desc.T3: The Diebold-Mariano test is not valid for comparing nested models; a test such as Clark-West is needed.
desc.T4: Using the same seed on every worker makes the parallel runs identical, so the study no longer has 2,000 independent draws.
